metaDescription: Siamese Mix vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Siamese Mix boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Colostrum fade is the clock behind this Siamese Mix table, and doses at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks exist to immunize the kitten while exposure (parks, foster homes, boarding intros) is rising.
Boarding desks ask for finished Siamese Mix dates, not intentions, so a Siamese Mix with only the first FVRCP dose is still incomplete for most facilities.
Dental disease shows up often enough in Siamese Mixs that vaccine day is also screening day — keep both on the same visit when possible.
Store the rabies label with the Siamese Mix profile immediately; lost paperwork is the most common reason Siamese Mix travel and kennel check-ins stall.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Delayed Siamese Mix boosters usually need one well-timed catch-up, not a homemade double dose, because spacing rules protect the kitten and guilt math does not.
Bring prior dates for every Siamese Mix row (8, 12, 16, 16 weeks on this page’s plan) so clinics can decide whether an extra FVRCP booster is required based on gap length and age.
If rabies was the missed Siamese Mix item, legal and boarding consequences stack on top of medical ones — restore compliance before the next Siamese Mix kennel reservation.
PetClues should hold both the new Siamese Mix due date and the certificate photo so household members stop arguing about which fridge sticky note is current.

faqs.question: When does the Siamese Mix core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Siamese Mix misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Siamese Mix health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Siamese Mix adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
